labels.O: the helper's own work first: help waits until the helper's mark is safe, finished or repaired, is withheld where it would endanger it, or serves it (a buffer)
labels.S: spare capacity: pixels, accounts, time or waking hours to spare
labels.T: terms between rooms: space given, no interference, an end to expansion, a favour returned, an earlier compromise or a third room's work kept
labels.B: a tie as the reason to help: a shared fandom, a sport, earlier friendliness
labels.K: help must be recognisable as help, or aimed at the right image
labels.U: the help hangs on a decision or a delivery the record leaves open, or it is refused
labels.E: the event's clock: help only while placement is open
